map.Marks the level (平) or oblique (仄) tone: Marks the level (ping) or oblique (ze) tone of every character against a built-in dictionary so you can check a classical poem against the expected tonal pattern.
map.床前明月光\n疑是地上霜\n举头望明月\n低头思故乡:
Before my bed the bright moonlight glows,
I wonder if it's frost upon the ground.
I raise my head to gaze at the moon,
I bow my head and think of home.
map.计算结果仅供参考，请以权威韵书为准: Results are for reference only; please defer to an authoritative rhyme book.
map.写完绝句或律诗后，逐字核对平仄是否合谱，重点看二四六字位。: After writing a quatrain or regulated verse, check each character against the tonal pattern, focusing on the even-numbered positions.
map.诗词教学：直观展示平仄交替与「一三五不论」的位置差异。: Teaching poetry: show tone alternation and why the first, third and fifth positions are flexible.
map.读诗时标注生僻字与多音字的平仄归属，减少翻查韵书。: Mark the tones of rare and polyphonic characters while reading, reducing rhyme-book lookups.
map.输入两行五言诗句 → 按句拆成单字并给出平 / 仄 / ？ 徽章 → 输出逐字平: Enter two five-character lines → split them into characters and mark each level, oblique or unknown → output a per-character tone string and compare the even positions with the metrical pattern
map.多音字和古入声字怎么判？: How are polyphonic and archaic entering-tone characters handled?
map.为什么有的字显示「？」？: Why do some characters show a question mark?
map.该字未收录在内置常用平声 / 仄声字库中，工具不会猜测其平仄；请查韵书后自行判断: That character is not in the built-in level / oblique dictionary, so the tool does not guess its tone. Check a rhyme book and decide yourself.
map.能替代韵书或格律谱吗？: Can it replace a rhyme book or metrical pattern?
map.不能。本工具只按内置字库逐字标注，不判断拗救、押韵与对仗；正式创作请对照格律谱与: No. It only marks tones from the built-in dictionary and does not judge tonal rescues, rhyming or antithesis. For serious writing, consult a metrical pattern and an authoritative rhyme book.
map.按句分行输出，句序与原诗一一对应: Output line by line, with line order matching the original poem.
map.支持五言、七言及任意字数的自由输入: Supports five-character, seven-character, and free-form input of any length.
map.格律诗自查：写完绝句 / 律诗后核对每字平仄是否合谱: Self-check for regulated verse: after writing a quatrain / octave, verify each character's tone against the pattern.
map.教学演示：直观展示平仄交替与「一三五不论」的位置差异: Teaching demo: visually show tone alternation and the positional difference of the "first-third-fifth flexible" rule.
map.读诗辅助：标注生僻字的平仄归属，降低查韵书成本: Reading aid: mark the tone of rare characters to reduce the cost of consulting rhyme books.
map.逐字标注平仄，辅助格律诗校验（按现代声调与古入声判定，多音字标「两读」，未收录标: Annotate the tone (level / oblique / both) of each character to aid classical-poem validation (modern Mandarin tones plus the classical entering-tone list; polyphonic characters are marked "both", unlisted characters show "?").
map.按换行切分为句、逐句去空白与标点后拆成单字；每字先查两读字库（跨平仄的多音字）命: Split into lines by newlines, strip whitespace and punctuation, then split each line into characters. For every character check the both-readings set first (polyphonic characters spanning level and oblique) and mark "both"; otherwise mark "level" on a hit in the level-tone set or "oblique" on a hit in the oblique-tone set. Characters absent from all three sets are marked "not listed" (shown as ?). Each line is rendered as character badges with tone markers.
map.逐字判定平仄：把每句按字拆开，命中平声字库（约 990 字）标「平」、命中仄声字: Per-character tone judgement: split each line into characters and mark "level" on a hit in the level-tone set (about 990 characters), "oblique" on a hit in the oblique-tone set (about 1,070 characters), and "both" on a hit in the both-readings set (38 polyphonic characters spanning level and oblique, such as 空/相/长/量); characters absent from all three sets show "?". The level set follows modern Mandarin tones 1 and 2 with classical entering-tone characters removed; the oblique set is tones 3 and 4 plus the common entering-tone characters of the Pingshui rhyme system. For a both-readings character, pick the reading the line requires; the authoritative rhyme book prevails.
map.平仄按现代普通话声调判定，并叠加平水韵入声常用字（如 白/石/竹 归仄）: Tones follow modern Mandarin pronunciation, with the common entering-tone characters of the Pingshui rhyme system counted as oblique (e.g. 白/石/竹).
map.跨平仄的多音字（空/相/长/量 等）标为「两读」，请按诗义择一: Polyphonic characters that span level and oblique (空/相/长/量 and others) are marked "both"; choose the reading the line requires.
map.说明：平仄按现代普通话声调 + 平水韵入声常用字判定；标「两读」的多音字请按诗义: Note: tones follow modern Mandarin pronunciation plus the common entering-tone characters of the Pingshui rhyme system. For characters marked "both", pick the reading the line requires; the authoritative rhyme book prevails.
map.跨平仄的多音字（空、相、长、量、王、看、过、为、应、重、行、将、当、难、间 等: The 38 polyphonic characters that span level and oblique (空, 相, 长, 量, 王, 看, 过, 为, 应, 重, 行, 将, 当, 难, 间 and others) are marked "both" instead of being forced into one tone; pick the reading the line requires. Entering-tone characters (白, 石, 竹, 国, 一, 不 and others) read as tones 1 or 2 in modern Mandarin but count as oblique in classical metrics, and this tool already merges them into the oblique set via the Pingshui entering-tone list. Results are indicative; the authoritative rhyme book prevails.
map.逐字标注格律诗的平仄：把输入诗句按字拆开，与内置的平声 / 仄声 / 两读字库比: Annotate the tones of a classical poem character by character: split the input into characters, compare against the built-in level / oblique / both-readings sets, mark each as "level", "oblique" or "both", show "?" for unlisted characters, and output the tone string line by line for comparison with a metrical pattern. The level set follows modern Mandarin tones 1 and 2 with entering-tone characters removed; the oblique set is tones 3 and 4 plus the common entering-tone characters of the Pingshui rhyme system.
map.逐字平仄标注，平 / 仄 / 两读 / 未收录四态着色: Per-character tone annotation with four-state coloring: level / oblique / both / unlisted.
map.内置平声约 990 字、仄声约 1070 字、两读 38 字字库，无需联网查韵书: Built-in sets of about 990 level-tone characters, about 1,070 oblique-tone characters and 38 both-readings characters, with no online rhyme book needed.
